messages:
ash: quick alert — ap-southeast2 flashpool-c is showing long attach tails for GPU jobs, ~22 pending.
tara: seeing nvme %util stuck high on a subset, but drives report low queue depth. could be background trim or GC.
ben: dmesg shows repeating admin timeouts + soft I/O errors on nvme1 on 2 hosts. snippet below.
ash: paste:
```
[ 2001.123456] nvme nvme1: Admin command timeout
[ 2001.123789] blk_update_request: I/O error, dev nvme1n1, sector 7654321
```
ops-bot: ALERT: GPU_PROVISIONER_HOLD ap-southeast2 flashpool-c: 22 pending at 1766629950
tara: timeline: we rolled fw v8.0.0 to flashpool-c last week and enabled nightly trim windows. looks like trim kicked in at 00:10 local while a large provisioning batch hit at 00:12.
ben: mitigation plan: 1) pause trim for flashpool-c cohort; 2) cordon noisy nodes and migrate pending attaches; 3) exclude pool from autoscaler for 30m.
ash: I can flip maintenance flag: `storage.trim.enabled=false` for cohort=flashpool-c. also will taint nodes: `nvme-deg:NoSchedule` for the 6 impacted machines.
ops-bot: maintenance flag applied to cohort flashpool-c at 1766630000
tara: doing node cordon+drain on 6 nodes now. moving only pending GPU attaches to healthy pools to avoid mass spill.
ben: note on cost: spilling >30% to us-west will incur egress and spot price variance. ops, please confirm budget for emergency spill.
oncall: logged incident INC-2026-2100 and notifying hardware team for 2 suspected drives requiring RMA.
ops-bot: autoscaler deploy started with `--exclude-pool=flashpool-c` at 1766630100
ash: after cordons attach success rose to ~82%. 2 hosts still show intermittent I/O errors; marking them for replacement, leaving 4 in monitored mode.
tara: follow-ups: add alert for nvme admin timeout rate >2 in 10m, add Grafana panel combining nvme %util, kernel I/O errs, and gpu-provisioner pending counts, and revise trim schedule to avoid 00:00-01:00 provisioning window.
ben: longer term: require firmware rollouts to include staggered trim schedules and an autoscaler rule to de-prioritize scrub/trim during provisioning surges.
ash: re-enable trim in 90m with concurrency=1 and monitor. cost tradeoff accepted for short spill. will write short postmortem and update runbook.
ops-bot: re-enable scheduled trim job for flashpool-c set for low concurrency at 1766630500
tara: thanks all, will run cohort health sweep tomorrow and propose a staggered rollout plan. :thumbsup:
